mentions.name: BoringMetrics
mentions.description: This remote logger, metrics, and user management tool lets developers track all their logs, live metrics, uptimes, and identify users in one hosted platform, centralizing observability for side projects. A v1 is targeted for the first quarter and it is already in use by its builder.
mentions.problem: Centralizing logs, metrics, uptimes, and user management for multiple side projects scattered across separate tools into a single platform.
mentions.audience: developers needing centralized logging, metrics, and user management across projects
mentions.source_excerpt: Second, a remote logger/metrics/user management tool where once can track all their logs, live metrics, uptimes, identify users, etc. I hope to have a v1 during this first quarter and I'm currently my first user as I have it hosted at https://app.getboringmetrics.com to centralize all my side projects into a single platform.
